title: Labby Code Mode Retained Fetch Response
description: Successful return value of the sandbox helper `codemode.fetch(handle)`, dispatched host-side as `__lab_internal::codemode_result_fetch`. Metadata is ALWAYS present; the payload is inlined only when it fits the per-call result ceiling (`calltool_result_max_bytes`).

size_bytes.description: Serialized byte length of the complete retained value.

token_estimate.description: ceil(size_bytes / token_estimate_divisor), floor 1. Same estimator as the response budget.

value_type.description: JSON type of the retained root value, so the caller can choose a slice strategy without inlining the payload.

array_length.description: Element count. Present only when `value_type` is `array`.

string_length.description: Length in Unicode scalar values (chars), NOT bytes. Present only when `value_type` is `string`.

object_keys.description: First 100 root keys in serialization order. Present only when `value_type` is `object`.

object_key_count.description: Total root key count, which may exceed the length of `object_keys`. Present only when `value_type` is `object`.

value_omitted.description: True when the retained value exceeded the per-call result ceiling and was therefore not inlined. The caller must page with `codemode.slice`.

value.description: The complete retained value. Present if and only if `value_omitted` is false.

guidance.description: Human/model-facing next step. Present when `value_omitted` is true.
